title: 70,000 social and affordable homes to be built across England as part of £39bn plan
summary: The UK government is investing £39bn to build 70,000 social and affordable homes across England, with funding allocated to regions including Greater Manchester, West Midlands, West Yorkshire, and London. This initiative aims to address the persistent shortage of affordable housing.
content: Funding has been granted to Greater Manchester, the West Midlands and West Yorkshire as well as £6bn for London.

zh.title: 英国计划投入390亿英镑建造7万套社会和经济适用房
zh.summary: 英国政府投资390亿英镑在全英格兰建造7万套社会和经济适用房，资金分配到大曼彻斯特、西米德兰兹、西约克郡和伦敦等地区。该举措旨在解决持续存在的经济适用房短缺问题。

title: US-Canada trade war escalates as Trump threatens tariff hike on autos after Carney vows to retaliate
summary: Trade tensions between the US and Canada are escalating as Trump threatens higher auto tariffs, prompting Canadian official Mark Carney to warn of retaliation and demand a change in approach. The dispute centers on tariffs that could significantly harm Canada's automotive industry.
content: Mark Carney accused Trump of wanting to "destroy" Canada's auto industry, and said he would only resume trade talks if the US comes with the "right attitude".

zh.title: 美加贸易战升级，特朗普威胁提高汽车关税，卡尼誓言报复
zh.summary: 随着特朗普威胁提高汽车关税，美加贸易紧张局势升级，加拿大官员马克·卡尼警告将进行报复并要求改变态度。争议的焦点是可能会对加拿大汽车产业造成重大伤害的关税。

title: Stock futures are flat as investors await Nvidia earnings, inflation report due later this week: Live updates
summary: Market sentiment remains cautious as investors await two major events this week: Nvidia's earnings report and an inflation report, both of which could significantly influence market direction and trading activity.
content: Investors turned cautious ahead of Nvidia's earnings and a closely watched inflation report. Both are due later this week.

zh.title: 投资者静候英伟达财报和通胀数据，股指期货持平
zh.summary: 随着投资者静候本周两大重要事件——英伟达财报和通胀数据——的公布，市场情绪保持谨慎。这两份报告都可能对市场走向和交易活动产生重大影响。

title: Paramount CEO David Ellison is at the final hurdle before buying WBD. So far, he can't clear it
summary: Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery faces a significant obstacle as state attorneys general challenge the deal on antitrust grounds, potentially blocking CEO David Ellison's planned purchase.
content: An antitrust challenge by a group of state attorneys general has left Paramount CEO David Ellison hunting for avenues to get his deal for WBD done.

zh.title: 派拉蒙CEO大卫·埃利森收购WBD临近最后关卡，迄今仍未突破
zh.summary: 派拉蒙收购华纳兄弟探索公司的交易面临重大障碍，各州检察长以反垄断理由对该交易提出质疑，可能阻止CEO大卫·埃利森的收购计划。

title: My father-in-law passed away, leaving a house with tenants. Do I evict them?
summary: A property inheritor who acquired a rental house with existing tenants faces uncertainty about next steps, as the rental arrangement details—whether signed leases or month-to-month agreements—remain unclear and will affect any eviction decision.
content: “We don’t know whether they have signed leases or are renting month to month.”

zh.title: 公公去世留下有租户的房子，我应该驱逐他们吗？
zh.summary: 继承了有现有租户的出租房产的业主对后续步骤感到困惑，因为租赁安排的细节（是否为签署的租约或月租协议）仍不清楚，这将影响任何驱逐决定。
